newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAGE BUYS U.S. LIFE INSURANCE FIRM.
newsitem.headline: SAGE BUYS U.S. LIFE INSURANCE FIRM.

text.p: South African life assurer Sage Group Ltd said on Tuesday it is to enter the U.S. market with the acquisition of The Fidelity Standard Life Insurance Co., in which it will invest an initial 70 million rand.

It said in a statement the purchase and the initial capitalisation of Fidelity, which has assets worth $450 million rand, would be funded from offshore. Sage in February raised $30.3 million when it placed offshore 5.82 million shares or 4.8 percent of its equity capital.
Sage said the acquisition had been approved by South Africa's central Reserve Bank. Various U.S. regulatory approvals were expected to be completed by December 31.

Once the acquisition was formalised it planned to establish a strategic partnership with a U.S. institution to provide enhanced financial ratings and selected outsourced services and/or distribution facilities. Negotiations in this regard had already started.
Its prerequisite in developing this business was to maintain at least joint control of the company and to have operational control.
Sage also said it planned, in due course, to set up a New York-based subsidiary of Fidelity Standard.
